capabilities: Run Pomodoro, short break, and long break countdowns
Play alarm sounds and send in-app and native notifications at period end
Track tasks with actual and estimated pomodoro counts
Open the timer in a sidebar, popout window, or floating modal
Persist tasks and settings as JSON inside the vault
disambiguation: Not the Pomofocus web app itself; an independent recreation of its timer running inside Obsidian.
extras: Popout window and window-focus features are desktop-only; alarm sounds are fetched and cached on first play if not bundled; settings are stored in .obsidian/fluent-pomofocus.json rather than the plugin folder so updates do not wipe tasks; first start requests OS notification permission.
intentEvidence: Obsidian plugin that recreates Pomofocus inside the vault
problem: Obsidian has no built-in pomodoro timer, so users must leave the app or use a separate tool to run focus/break sessions.
summary: Pomodoro timer plugin that recreates Pomofocus inside Obsidian with a drift-free countdown, alarms, task tracking, and sidebar, popout, or floating surfaces.
